records.label: spacr.multiple_testing.estimate_pi0#1
records.source: Uses the smoothed bootstrap-free spline-free estimator: pi0(lambda) is computed over a grid and the estimate is taken at the largest lambda whose value is stable, then clipped to (0, 1]. With few tests the grid collapses and the estimator returns 1.0, which makes the q-values fall back to Benjamini-Hochberg -- the conservative answer, not an error.
records.context: Uses the smoothed bootstrap-free spline-free estimator: pi0(lambda) is computed over a grid and the estimate is taken at the largest lambda whose value is stable, then clipped to (0, 1]. With few tests the grid collapses and the estimator returns 1.0, which makes the q-values fall back to Benjamini-Hochberg -- the conservative answer, not an error.
records.translation: Notar sléttaða metilinn án bootstrap og án splína: pi0(lambda) er reiknað á grind og matið tekið við stærsta lambda þar sem gildið er stöðugt, síðan skorið við bilið (0, 1]. Þegar prófin eru fá fellur grindin saman og metillinn skilar 1.0; þá nota q-gildin Benjamini-Hochberg sem varaleið -- varfærna niðurstöðu, ekki villu.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.file_list#3
records.source: **Add files...** opens a file dialog with multi-selection enabled. Pressing it again *appends*, so several sources can be gathered from different folders in several trips rather than one impossible single selection.
records.context: **Add files...** opens a file dialog with multi-selection enabled. Pressing it again *appends*, so several sources can be gathered from different folders in several trips rather than one impossible single selection.
records.translation: **Bæta við skrám...** opnar skráarglugga þar sem hægt er að velja margar skrár. Þegar ýtt er aftur á hnappinn er skrám *bætt við*, þannig að hægt er að safna mörgum gagnalindum úr ólíkum möppum í nokkrum ferðum í stað einnar óframkvæmanlegrar valaðgerðar.

records.label: spacr.regression_diagnostics.write_diagnostic_suite#1
records.source: Nothing is required: pass what a given analysis mode has. The permutation test has a design and P values but no fitted values; a simultaneous fit has all of them. Each block is skipped silently when its inputs are absent, and a block that raises is recorded as an error rather than aborting the run -- a diagnostic that fails must never take the analysis down with it.
records.context: Nothing is required: pass what a given analysis mode has. The permutation test has a design and P values but no fitted values; a simultaneous fit has all of them. Each block is skipped silently when its inputs are absent, and a block that raises is recorded as an error rather than aborting the processing session -- a diagnostic that fails must never take the analysis down with it.
records.translation: Ekkert er áskilið: sendu inn það sem viðkomandi greiningarhamur hefur. Umraðana-prófið hefur hönnun og P-gildi en engin aðlöguð gildi; samtímis aðlögun hefur þetta allt. Hverjum hluta er sleppt hljóðlega þegar inntak hans vantar, og ef hluti kastar villu er hún skráð í stað þess að stöðva vinnslulotuna -- bilað greiningarskref má aldrei fella sjálfa greininguna.

records.label: spacr.schema.escape_field_stem_plate#1
records.source: Writers know the grammar and therefore know how many fixed tail tokens belong to the well/field/time.  Joining everything before that tail is the unambiguous plate id; escaping it before emitting a crop filename is what lets the reader split the name without guessing.
records.context: Writers know the grammar and therefore know how many fixed tail tokens belong to the microplate sample position/microscope field of view/time.  Joining everything before that tail is the unambiguous laboratory microplate id; escaping it before emitting an extracted image region filename is what lets the reader split the name without guessing.
records.translation: Skrifarar þekkja málfræðina og vita því hve mörg föst endatákn tilheyra staðsetningu sýnis á örplötu/sjónsviði smásjár/tíma.  Þegar öll táknin á undan þeim hala eru sameinuð fæst ótvírætt auðkenni rannsóknarstofuplötunnar; með því að kóða það áður en skráarheiti fyrir útdregið myndsvæði er skrifað getur lesarinn skipt heitinu án ágiskunar.
